# Running development conversations (general guidance)

Managers hold development conversations to agree goals, discuss support and plan growth.
Good practice: prepare shared notes, ask open questions, agree two or three concrete next steps,
and document outcomes together. Performance decisions about individuals are taken by people, following
the HR policy, and are outside the scope of this guide.
